item.title: Korea Small-Cap Filings Brief — 2026-11-20
item.description: VAIV Company reported completing a KRW 2.99bn third-party rights offering of 1,827,628 new shares, fully subscribed by one investment fund. · PhionX (formerly Amerridge Corporation) reported a public offering of 112,900 common shares raising KRW 118,093,400 (118,093,400원). · GNCO decided a third-party allotment rights offering of 1,113,172 common shares at KRW 2,695 per share, raising about KRW 3.0bn. · Robotis signed a KRW 3.98bn (39.78억원) DYNAMIXEL-X supply contract with Pollen Robotics SAS of France, equal to 10.22% of revenue. · Deokshin EPC signed a KRW 11.42bn (114.19억원) construction contract with Samsung C&T for Pyeongtaek Campus P5 FAB2.
